exclusions.reason: Static image and SVG assets are referenced by HTML/CSS but own no rendered UI logic and are not valid point-and-edit source anchors.
Figma Make tooling configuration files are not UI source anchors.
Claude Code harness configuration and permission files are not rendered UI source.
Git internals are not source files of any kind.
Markdown files are design, product and brand documentation; they contain no rendered UI source.
Product surface documentation describes intent and contains no rendered UI source.
Decision logs and plans contain no rendered UI source.
Lint and verification scripts are tooling, not rendered UI source.

generated.explanation: Repository is a self-contained vanilla HTML/CSS/JS design system with no framework or build system. Rendered UI lives in the launcher (index.html + launcher/), the token layer (system/tokens/), and the prototypes (prototypes/). Documentation, assets and tooling own no rendered UI.
